releaseNotes: Adds 16 contextual Bible dictionary studies: High priest, Inheritance, Intertestamental period, Kingdom of heaven, Kinsman-redeemer, Leprosy, Laying on of hands, Mediation, Mercy seat, New birth, Offering, Ordination, Passover lamb, Pentateuch, Priesthood and Redemption of creation. Expands the study set from 139 to 155 across 205 terms, with interpretive cautions and KJV-validated references. Retains the YouVersion and optional API.Bible provider selector.
